title: StokSMP
description: A vanilla free to play minecraft server! No crazy plugins.
body:
Welcome on the stoksmp! A english (and dutch) minecraft server. In our server you can't find any paid features. We also pay for the server so there is no lag. We almost have 300 members. Will you be part off it?

We also support bedrock :D

Joining the discord 100% recommended (not needed)
